format: Envelopes carry env, type, id, rev, saltID, fields and stamps. op decode: bytesBase64 are stored payload bytes; expect is the decoded envelope (deep-equal), expectSummary checks a large one by its decoded JSON's size and sha256, expectError names the failure, expectSpilled lists the fields holding a {"$file": FileRef} reference. op spillDecision: whether a string of utf8Bytes in type.field spills (above 32 KiB, plain scalar string fields only, never a field marked spill: false, an enum, or a set, whose elements are keys under their own stamps). op cocoaToMs: Math.round((cocoaSeconds + 978307200) * 1000) in IEEE double, half away from zero. op msRoundTrip: ms / 1000 - 978307200 gives cocoaSeconds, and cocoaToMs of it gives ms back. op roundTrip: decoding then encoding then decoding envelope gives envelope back. op storageForm: an encoded JSON of jsonBytes is stored plain or gzip (gzip only above 16 KiB; compressed bytes are not compared, encoders differ). op sizeCheck: stored payload bytes against the 256 KiB cap. op stampValid: the stamp grammar ^[LSXNT][0-9]{13}\.[0-9]{4}\.[a-z2-7]{8}$. op stampCompare: -1, 0 or 1 comparing the 27 characters after the letter as plain strings. op patch: a RecordPatch of type and id with changes (field: {value} for a scalar's whole new value, null clearing it, or {elements} for a map's keys, null removing one, or a set's elements, true or false) applied to held (an envelope; null: a new one with that type, id and saltID) = expect, the envelope after, with expectStamped the paths that got a stamp, sorted (a scalar field's name, or field[key]); stamps gives the stamp the writer mints for each path. A value equal to the one held is dropped and keeps its stamp (rule 9), and so is a string whose sha256 hex is the hash of the satellite the field spilled into; every stamped write sets rev to the schema revision; keys, elements and fields the patch does not name stay as held. expectError names a refusal: wrongRecord (another type or id), unknownField (a field the schema does not list), wrongKind (a whole value for a map or set, or elements for a scalar), notASetElement (a set element that is not true or false), leavesTerminalValue (a change of a field out of one of its terminalValues in the schema, Card.status retired, to any other value; the same value again is dropped by rule 9). A refused patch changes nothing. decode refuses as notAnEnvelope gzip that would inflate past limits.payloadMaxInflatedBytes (16777216): a trailer whose size is over it, or a stream that inflates past what its trailer says, refused without inflating more than the claim plus one byte. decode adds unsupportedEnvelope (an env other than 1) and invalidStamp (a stamp outside the grammar, or a stamps entry that is neither a stamp nor an object of stamps).
